verdict.rationale: Penpot publishes an llms.txt at penpot.app/llms.txt that an agent can be pointed at, but the cited content is product-overview material (a Figma comparison and a plugin count). The probe found no llms.txt on the technical help docs site (help.penpot.app). That is a different host, so it limits depth rather than contradicting the claim. missing for 10: llms.txt or agent-oriented coverage of the technical/help documentation, evidence that the llms.txt indexes in-depth docs (API, plugins, MCP setup), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use of these docs

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Penpot vs Figma: Open-source alternative with self-hosting, unlimited files, native design tokens.
Plugins (113+): Community plugin marketplace with accessibility, code, AI, and design system tools.
